beginner.summary: For developers, operations engineers and SREs who are starting with Dynatrace. Covers the platform with Grail, Smartscape and Dynatrace Intelligence, a trial environment with OneAgent and ActiveGate, infrastructure and topology, services and distributed traces, logs in Grail, DQL, Notebooks and Dashboards, Davis problems and root cause analysis, anomaly detection, Kubernetes with the Dynatrace Operator, frontend observability, synthetic monitoring, OpenTelemetry, alerting with Workflows, SLOs and Site Reliability Guardian, application security, access management and troubleshooting deployments. Covers the Dynatrace Associate topics.
prerequisites: Runs or supports applications on Linux, containers or cloud services
Knows what metrics, logs and traces are
outcomes: Deploy OneAgent, ActiveGate and the Dynatrace Operator and read the Smartscape topology
Investigate services, traces, logs and Davis problems with DQL, Notebooks and Dashboards
Monitor users, synthetic journeys, SLOs and OpenTelemetry data
Alert with Workflows, manage access and fix deployment problems

days.topic: Dynatrace Overview: Platform, Grail, Smartscape and Dynatrace Intelligence
subtopics: Dynatrace as an observability and security platform
Course project overview: a microservice shop on Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Tour a Dynatrace environment with demo data, follow one problem from its Davis card to the affected service, trace and log line, and draw how the platform parts connect.
days.deliverable: Platform map with one followed problem
checks: One problem is traced to its service, trace and log
Each platform part's job is correct on the map
Grail, Smartscape and Davis are explained in plain words

days.topic: Lab Setup: Dynatrace Trial, OneAgent and ActiveGate
subtopics: Full-stack, infrastructure and discovery monitoring modes
Smoke test in the Hosts app
days.lab_task: Start a trial environment, install OneAgent on two hosts in different host groups, install an ActiveGate, restart the course services and confirm deep monitoring in the Hosts and Services apps.
days.deliverable: Monitored lab hosts with an ActiveGate
checks: Both hosts report with the chosen monitoring mode
objectives: Organise hosts with groups and tags

days.topic: Infrastructure Observability: Hosts, Processes and Networks
subtopics: Infrastructure monitoring for virtual machines and clouds
days.lab_task: Find the host and process behind a seeded memory problem, check its network connections, set a maintenance window for a planned restart and add an automatic tagging rule.
checks: The process with the memory problem is identified
New hosts get tags from the rule

days.topic: Smartscape and Topology: Services, Processes and Dependencies
subtopics: Smartscape layers: applications, services, processes and hosts
days.lab_task: Map the course shop's dependencies in Smartscape, find every service that depends on the database and list them with a DQL query.
days.deliverable: Dependency map and DQL topology query
checks: Dependencies across all layers are shown
Services that call the database are listed
The DQL query returns the same services

days.topic: Services and Distributed Traces
subtopics: Service health: response time, failures and throughput
days.lab_task: Find the slowest endpoint of the shop, open a distributed trace, locate the hotspot in the code-level view and jump to the logs for the same request.
checks: The hotspot is found in the trace
Logs for the same trace are shown

days.topic: Logs in Grail: Ingest, Processing and the Logs App
subtopics: Log ingest from OneAgent, APIs and OpenTelemetry
days.lab_task: Ingest the shop's logs, parse order IDs and status codes in OpenPipeline, mask card numbers, create a metric for errors and find logs for one order.
days.deliverable: Parsed, masked logs with a log metric
checks: Order IDs and status codes become fields
Card numbers are masked before storage
The error metric matches error log counts

days.topic: DQL: Fetch, Filter, Summarize and Join
subtopics: DQL structure: fetch, filter and fields
days.lab_task: Answer five operational questions with DQL, including error rate by service, slowest database calls and orders per minute, and save the queries in a notebook.
checks: Each question has a working query
A join combines logs and spans for the same request
One result matches the Services app

days.topic: Notebooks and Dashboards
subtopics: Tiles from DQL, metrics and code
days.lab_task: Build a team dashboard for the shop with DQL tiles and variables for service and environment, and an investigation notebook linked from it.
checks: The dashboard shows traffic, errors and latency
Team members can open it with the right access

days.topic: Davis Problems and Root Cause Analysis
days.lab_task: Seed a database slowdown, follow the Davis problem from impact to root cause, compare Davis's answer with the seeded cause and record the time to root cause.
days.deliverable: Problem analysis with time to root cause
checks: Davis opens one problem for the slowdown
The root cause matches the seeded fault
Time from symptom to root cause is recorded

days.topic: Anomaly Detection: Baselines, Thresholds and Custom Detectors
subtopics: Detecting anomalies in logs and business data
days.lab_task: Create a custom anomaly detector for failed orders from a DQL time series, tune its sensitivity on seeded data and test that it raises a problem.
checks: The detector runs on the DQL time series
A seeded anomaly opens a problem

days.topic: Kubernetes Observability with the Dynatrace Operator
subtopics: The Dynatrace Operator and DynaKube resource
Kubernetes app: clusters, namespaces and workloads
days.lab_task: Deploy the Dynatrace Operator with cloud-native full-stack monitoring, find a crash-looping workload, check its events and logs and list over-provisioned workloads.
checks: The DynaKube is ready and pods are injected
The crash-looping workload and its cause are found

days.topic: Frontend Observability: Real User Monitoring, Session Replay and Error Inspector
subtopics: Real User Monitoring for web applications
Linking user actions to backend traces
days.lab_task: Turn on RUM for the shop front end, find the slowest page by Web Vitals, replay a failed checkout session and follow the error to its backend trace.
checks: The error links to its backend trace

days.topic: Synthetic Monitoring: HTTP Monitors and Browser Clickpaths
days.lab_task: Create an HTTP monitor for the shop API, a browser clickpath for checkout and a private location for an internal page, then break checkout and confirm the alert.
days.deliverable: Synthetic monitors with an alert test
checks: Monitors pass against the healthy shop
Breaking checkout fails the clickpath and alerts
The private location tests the internal page

days.topic: OpenTelemetry with Dynatrace
days.lab_task: Instrument a service that cannot run OneAgent with the OpenTelemetry SDK, send its data through the collector and confirm it joins traces from OneAgent services.
days.deliverable: OpenTelemetry service joined to existing traces
checks: Traces, metrics and logs arrive over OTLP
Traces continue across OneAgent and OpenTelemetry services
Resource attributes show the service correctly

days.topic: Alerting and Notifications: Problem Notifications and Workflows
subtopics: Problem notifications to email, Slack and Teams
days.lab_task: Build a workflow that sends payment problems to the payments team channel with context, opens a ticket for severe problems and ignores problems in test environments.
checks: Payment problems reach the payments channel

days.topic: Service-Level Objectives and Site Reliability Guardian
days.lab_task: Create SLOs for checkout availability and latency, add burn-rate alerts and a guardian that checks them after each deployment, then fail a release that breaks them.
checks: Both SLOs show status and error budget
A fast burn raises an alert
The guardian fails the bad release

days.topic: Application Security: Runtime Vulnerability Analytics and Attack Protection
subtopics: Vulnerabilities in third-party libraries and code
days.lab_task: Find vulnerable libraries in the shop services, rank them by exposure, block a seeded injection attack with runtime protection and track fixes.
checks: Vulnerable libraries are listed per service

days.topic: Access Management: Users, Groups, Policies and Segments
days.lab_task: Create groups for developers and support, give each access only to its applications' data with policies and security context, define a segment per team and review audit logs.
checks: Support staff see only their applications' data
Each team's segment filters its data
Access changes appear in audit logs

days.topic: Troubleshooting Dynatrace Deployments: OneAgent, ActiveGate and Missing Data
days.lab_task: Diagnose four seeded problems, an unmonitored process, a disconnected ActiveGate, missing logs and a wrong host group, fix each one and record the steps.
checks: Data flows correctly after each fix
A check or alert catches each problem

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Observability for the Microservice Shop with Dynatrace
days.lab_task: Deliver observability for the microservice shop with OneAgent and the Operator, processed logs, a team dashboard, DQL notebooks, SLOs, synthetic checkout tests, alerting workflows and an incident drill.
days.deliverable: Working shop observability with a demo
checks: One request is followed from browser to database
Davis and SLO alerts fire on seeded failures
The drill reaches the root cause with Davis and DQL

intermediate.summary: For engineers who run Dynatrace for several teams. Covers OpenPipeline, DQL in depth, business events, Workflows and AutomationEngine, monitoring as code with Monaco and Terraform, cloud platform monitoring, Kubernetes at scale, log management with buckets and retention, Davis AI in depth, Dynatrace Assist and Dynatrace Intelligence agents, tracing in depth, database and messaging monitoring, release validation, Extensions, Live Debugger, enterprise application monitoring, platform subscription usage, security analytics and Associate and Professional exam preparation.
prerequisites: Has deployed OneAgent and used DQL, dashboards and problems
Comfortable with YAML and infrastructure as code
outcomes: Process, store and query telemetry and business data at scale with OpenPipeline, buckets and DQL
Automate monitoring configuration and responses with Monaco, Terraform and Workflows
Monitor clouds, Kubernetes, databases, messaging and enterprise applications in depth
Use Davis and Dynatrace Intelligence agents, control consumption and prepare for the Associate and Professional exams

days.topic: OpenPipeline: Ingest Routing, Processing and Data Extraction
subtopics: OpenPipeline stages: routing, processing and storage
Pipelines for logs, events, spans and business events
Processors: parse, mask, drop and enrich
Extracting metrics and events from records
days.lab_task: Build pipelines that route the shop's logs by team, drop debug records, extract a metric and a business event from order logs and store them in the right buckets.
checks: Each team's logs land in its bucket
The metric and business event appear from order logs

days.topic: DQL in Depth: Parsing, Time Series, Lookups and Performance
days.lab_task: Parse a complex log format with DPL, build time series of checkout latency percentiles by region, join them with entity data and cut the query's scanned data in half.
checks: Latency percentiles by region are correct
Scanned data halves for the same answer

days.topic: Business Events and Business Analytics
subtopics: Business events from OneAgent, APIs and logs
days.lab_task: Capture order and payment business events, build a checkout business flow, find where revenue is lost and link the loss to a technical problem.
days.deliverable: Business flow with a revenue analysis
checks: Order and payment events arrive with amounts
The checkout flow shows drop-off per step
Revenue loss is linked to a technical problem

days.topic: Workflows and AutomationEngine
subtopics: Workflow triggers: events, schedules and problems
Tasks: DQL, HTTP, JavaScript and app actions
days.lab_task: Build a workflow that, on a disk problem, queries the host's usage, cleans temporary files after approval and posts a summary, then test failure handling.
checks: The disk problem starts the workflow
A failed task is retried and reported

days.topic: Monitoring as Code with Monaco and Terraform
days.lab_task: Download existing dashboards and alerting into Monaco, apply them to a second environment through a pipeline and manage SLOs with Terraform.
checks: Existing configuration is in the repository
The second environment matches the first
SLOs are created and changed through Terraform

days.topic: Cloud Platform Monitoring: AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
tools: AWS, Azure and Google Cloud integrations
days.lab_task: Connect one cloud account, monitor a managed database and a serverless function, import cloud tags and build a multi-cloud health dashboard.
checks: Cloud tags are available on entities
The dashboard shows health across clouds

days.topic: Kubernetes at Scale: Monitoring Modes, Namespaces and Workload Health
days.lab_task: Roll out the Operator to three clusters with different modes, assign workloads to owners, alert on unhealthy workloads and upgrade the Operator safely.
checks: All three clusters report with their modes
The Operator upgrade completes without data gaps

days.topic: Log Management at Scale: Buckets, Retention and Cost
subtopics: Bucket design by team and retention
days.lab_task: Design buckets for three teams with different retention, cut stored log volume by 30% with OpenPipeline and report log usage per team.
days.deliverable: Bucket design with volume and cost results
checks: Each team's logs have the right bucket and retention
Log usage is shown per team

days.topic: Davis AI in Depth: Causal, Predictive and Generative Intelligence
subtopics: Generative AI for questions and summaries
days.lab_task: Forecast disk usage for the shop database, explain a seeded problem with causal analysis and ask generative AI for a summary, then check each answer against the data.
days.deliverable: Forecast, causal analysis and verified summary
checks: The forecast shows when the disk fills
Causal analysis finds the seeded cause
The generated summary matches the data
objectives: Use causal, predictive and generative AI

days.topic: Dynatrace Assist and Dynatrace Intelligence Agents
subtopics: Dynatrace Assist as the conversational interface
Agents for investigation, remediation and development
When to keep humans in the loop
days.lab_task: Investigate two replayed problems with Dynatrace Assist, compare its findings with the known causes and query Dynatrace from a coding agent through the MCP server.
checks: Assist findings are compared with known causes
The coding agent reads Dynatrace data through MCP
Agent actions follow permissions and approvals

days.topic: Distributed Tracing in Depth: Sampling, Request Attributes and Span Data
subtopics: Span attributes and span data in Grail
days.lab_task: Add request attributes for customer tier and order value, define a custom service for a background job and use DQL on spans to find slow orders for premium customers.
checks: The background job appears as a service
Slow premium orders are found with DQL

days.topic: Database and Message Queue Monitoring
subtopics: Message queues: Kafka, RabbitMQ and cloud queues
days.lab_task: Find the slowest database statement and its caller, monitor Kafka consumer lag with an extension and alert when lag grows during a seeded slowdown.
days.deliverable: Database and queue monitoring with alerts
checks: The slowest statement and its caller are found
Consumer lag is shown per group

days.topic: Release Validation and Deployment Events with Site Reliability Guardian
subtopics: Guardians with SLO and DQL objectives
days.lab_task: Send deployment events from the CI pipeline, validate each release with a guardian, block a bad version and compare versions after release.
checks: Deployments appear as events on services
The guardian blocks the bad version

days.topic: Extensions: Extensions Framework, Prometheus Data and SNMP
days.lab_task: Collect Prometheus metrics from a service, monitor a network device over SNMP and write a small SQL extension for a business table.
checks: The SQL extension reports the business metric

days.topic: Live Debugger and Developer Observability
subtopics: Breakpoints that do not stop code
days.lab_task: Use Live Debugger to capture variable snapshots for a seeded bug in production without a redeploy, find the cause and verify the fix.
checks: Sensitive fields are masked in snapshots
The error stops after the fix

days.topic: Enterprise Application Monitoring: SAP, Mainframe and Packaged Applications
subtopics: End-to-end traces across old and new systems
days.lab_task: Trace a request from the shop front end into a seeded legacy order system, monitor its middleware and build a dashboard for the business transaction.
checks: The request is followed into the legacy system
The business transaction dashboard shows volume and errors
objectives: Trace across old and new systems

days.topic: Cost and Consumption: Dynatrace Platform Subscription and Usage
days.lab_task: Analyse a month of consumption by capability and team, set a budget alert, find three savings and report the result.
checks: Consumption is split by capability and team
A budget alert fires at the threshold

days.topic: Security Analytics in Grail: Investigations, Posture and Threat Observability
subtopics: Threat detection on logs and events
days.lab_task: Investigate a seeded credential attack across logs and spans with DQL, review posture findings for the cluster and automate a response workflow.
checks: The workflow runs on the attack event

days.topic: Dynatrace Associate and Professional Exam Preparation
subtopics: Associate exam topics: platform, problems, DQL and Workflows
Professional exam topics and practical tasks
Mapping course days to exam topics
Practice tasks in a lab environment
days.lab_task: Take a timed Associate practice set and three Professional-style tasks, map every miss to a course day and complete a review plan.
checks: The practice set and tasks are completed under time limits
Each miss is mapped to a course day
The review plan covers the weakest topics

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Automated Observability Platform for the Microservice Shop
days.lab_task: Run Dynatrace for three teams with pipelines and buckets, configuration as code, Kubernetes and data service monitoring, business flows, automated remediation, release validation and a consumption report.
checks: Configuration and responses run from code and Workflows
Each team finds the cause of a seeded problem

advanced.summary: For observability leads and architects who run Dynatrace across an enterprise. Covers architecture for large enterprises, Grail data architecture, large-scale rollouts, moving from Managed and classic features to the latest platform, agentic operations with Dynatrace Intelligence agents and the MCP server, autonomous remediation, AI observability, regulated environments, platform engineering with Dynatrace, building apps with AppEngine, business observability, cost and carbon optimisation, hybrid and multi-cloud strategy, security operations, SLO programmes, high-volume analytics, ITSM and CI/CD integrations, a centre of excellence and troubleshooting at scale.
prerequisites: Runs Dynatrace for several teams in production
Responsible for observability strategy, cost or compliance
outcomes: Design Dynatrace environments, Grail data and rollouts for an enterprise
Run agentic operations and autonomous remediation with guardrails
Build apps, business observability and AI observability on the platform
Govern cost, security, integrations and a centre of excellence

days.topic: Dynatrace Architecture for Large Enterprises: Environments, Tenants and Data Governance
subtopics: Separating production, test and regulated units
days.lab_task: Design the Dynatrace layout for a company with three regions and a regulated unit, place ActiveGates in network zones and defend the design in a review.
checks: Environments, zones and ActiveGates are defined
Regulated data stays in its environment
The review records decisions and risks

days.topic: Grail Data Architecture: Buckets, Segments, Retention and Permissions
subtopics: Retention by data value and regulation
days.lab_task: Design buckets, segments and record-level permissions for ten teams, apply retention by data type and prove that teams see only their data.
days.deliverable: Grail data design with access tests
checks: Buckets and segments cover all teams
Retention matches data type and rules
Access tests show each team only its data

days.topic: Large-Scale Rollout and Deployment Automation for OneAgent
subtopics: Automated OneAgent installation with configuration management
Host groups and naming at scale
days.lab_task: Plan a three-wave rollout to 2,000 hosts, automate installation with configuration management, control updates and report coverage after the first wave.
days.deliverable: Rollout plan, automation and coverage report
checks: Waves, modes and host groups are defined
Coverage after the first wave is reported

days.topic: Moving from Dynatrace Managed and Classic Features to the Latest Platform
subtopics: Moving from classic logs to Grail
Training users on the new apps
Running old and new in parallel
days.lab_task: Migrate a team's classic dashboards, alerting profiles and log queries to the latest apps and DQL, run both in parallel for a week and compare results.
checks: Dashboards and alerts work in the new apps
Log and metric queries return the same answers in DQL
The cutover plan has dates and owners
objectives: Move to the latest Dynatrace platform
Run old and new in parallel

days.topic: Agentic Operations: Dynatrace Intelligence Agents, MCP Server and Guardrails
subtopics: Grounding agents in Grail and Smartscape facts
The MCP server for external agents
days.lab_task: Evaluate Dynatrace agents on fifteen replayed problems, connect an external agent through the MCP server, define guardrails and decide which actions may run without a human.
checks: Agents are scored on correct diagnosis and safe actions
The external agent works within its permissions
Unattended actions are limited to proven cases

days.topic: Autonomous Remediation with Workflows and Approval Gates
subtopics: Verifying the result of a fix
days.lab_task: Build remediation workflows for three common problems with approval gates by risk, verify each fix with DQL and roll back when verification fails.
checks: Each problem is fixed by its workflow
Fixes are checked with DQL before closing
A failed fix is rolled back

days.topic: AI Observability: LLMs, Agents and GPU Workloads
days.lab_task: Monitor an AI assistant with tool calls and a self-hosted model, track token cost and GPU use, detect a quality drop and gate a model change on the results.
days.deliverable: AI observability with a release gate
checks: Agent steps and tool calls are traced
Token cost and GPU use are shown
The model change is blocked when quality drops

days.topic: Observability for Regulated Industries: Data Privacy, Masking and Audit
subtopics: Data masking at capture and ingest
Personal data in traces, logs and sessions
days.lab_task: Apply masking rules for personal data across traces, logs and sessions, set retention that meets a deletion duty and produce an audit evidence pack.
checks: Personal data is masked in every data type
Data is removed when its retention ends
The evidence pack answers audit questions

days.topic: Platform Engineering with Dynatrace: Self-Service Onboarding and Golden Paths
subtopics: Observability as part of the internal platform
Golden path templates with monitoring included
Standard dashboards, SLOs and alerts as code
days.lab_task: Add Dynatrace onboarding to a golden path so new services get ownership, dashboards, SLOs and alerts automatically, and measure time to first useful alert.
checks: A new service gets monitoring without a ticket
Alerts go to the owner from catalogue data
Time to first useful alert is recorded

days.topic: Building Dynatrace Apps with AppEngine and the Dynatrace SDK
subtopics: App structure and the Dynatrace SDK
days.lab_task: Build an app that shows each team its services, open problems and SLO status, with an action that opens a ticket, and deploy it to the environment.
checks: The app shows services, problems and SLOs for a team
The ticket action works with the right permissions
The app is deployed and used by the team

days.topic: Business Observability at Scale: Journeys, KPIs and Revenue Impact
days.lab_task: Model three customer journeys across systems, report revenue impact for a seeded incident and present a business reliability dashboard to the leadership persona.
days.deliverable: Journey models and revenue impact report
checks: Revenue impact of the incident is calculated
Leaders can read business reliability at a glance

days.topic: Capacity, Cost and Carbon: Infrastructure Optimisation with Dynatrace
days.lab_task: Find idle and over-provisioned resources, estimate cost and carbon savings, automate a rightsizing recommendation workflow and report the result.
checks: Idle and over-provisioned resources are listed
Cost and carbon savings are estimated
The recommendation workflow runs on schedule

days.topic: Hybrid and Multi-Cloud Observability Strategy
subtopics: Observability across data centres and clouds
OneAgent and OpenTelemetry in the strategy
Standard tags and ownership across sites
Network paths and dependencies between sites
Cloud-native and legacy in one view
days.lab_task: Write a hybrid observability strategy for a company with two clouds and a data centre, including standards, tool consolidation and a roadmap with measures.
checks: Standards cover tags, ownership and instrumentation
Tool consolidation saves cost with no coverage loss

days.topic: Security Operations at Scale: Detection, Response and SIEM Integration
subtopics: Security use cases on the platform
days.lab_task: Design security operations for the estate with detections, response workflows and SIEM forwarding, run a joint exercise with the SOC persona and report response times.
days.deliverable: Security operations design and exercise report
checks: Detections fire on the exercise attack
Response workflows run and are logged

days.topic: Reliability Engineering at Scale: SLO Programmes and Release Gates
days.lab_task: Roll out tiered SLOs as code for thirty services, add guardians to every pipeline and run a quarterly reliability review with SLO and problem data.
days.deliverable: SLO programme with a quarterly review
checks: Thirty services have SLOs by tier

days.topic: High-Volume Log and Event Analytics: Performance and Query Optimisation
days.lab_task: Rewrite the five most expensive dashboard queries to scan less data, add pre-aggregated metrics for two of them and show the consumption saving.
checks: Rewritten queries give the same answers

days.topic: ITSM and CI/CD Integration: ServiceNow, Jira and Pipelines
subtopics: ServiceNow integration for incidents and CMDB
Jira integration for problems and fixes
days.lab_task: Connect problems to ServiceNow incidents with CMDB data, create Jira issues for fixes, gate a pipeline on Dynatrace data and close tickets automatically when problems resolve.
checks: Problems open one incident each with CMDB context
The pipeline stops on a failed quality gate

days.topic: Governance and a Centre of Excellence for Dynatrace
days.lab_task: Design a centre of excellence with roles, standards and a support model, onboard a new team with templates and report adoption and value after a month.
days.deliverable: Centre of excellence plan and onboarding report
checks: Roles, standards and support are defined
The new team is productive within a week

days.topic: Troubleshooting at Scale: Data Gaps, Agent Issues and Query Limits
days.lab_task: Diagnose seeded problems, a data gap on a host group, an overloaded ActiveGate and queries hitting limits, fix them and write an incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnoses, fixes and an incident review
checks: Each problem's cause is shown with evidence
Data and queries work within limits after the fixes
objectives: Write a post-incident review of a monitoring incident with the root cause and a preventive action

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Dynatrace Strategy and Autonomous Operations Design
days.lab_task: Present an enterprise Dynatrace strategy to a review board with the architecture and Grail data design, rollout and migration plan, agentic operations with guardrails, business and AI observability, cost and security plans and the centre of excellence.
days.deliverable: Strategy with evidence and a board decision
checks: Architecture and data design pass review
Agent and remediation guardrails are tested
Cost, security and governance plans have owners
